classes.notes: Holds nothing across a clear-data sweep; never exported and never placed in a support bundle.
classes.summary: A memory-only derived projection rebuilt on demand and evicted when its scope changes.

classes.notes: Clear-data drops the cache; the view rebuilds from authority and exports metadata only.
classes.summary: A local cache/db materialization cleared and rebuilt from authoritative inputs.

classes.notes: Survives a clear-data sweep, can be held for offboarding, and is restored from the saved copy, not rebuilt from authority.
classes.summary: A saved, user-authored snapshot artifact captured at a point in time.

classes.notes: Clear-data revokes the local replica; hold and offboarding follow the managed retention policy.
classes.summary: A service-backed or locally mirrored replica reconciled from a managed source.

disposition_matrix.rationale: ephemeral_projection under clear_data resolves to evicted_from_memory by class policy.
ephemeral_projection under export resolves to excluded_no_persisted_state by class policy.
ephemeral_projection under support_bundle resolves to excluded_from_bundle by class policy.
ephemeral_projection under offboarding resolves to nothing_to_hold by class policy.
ephemeral_projection under restore resolves to rebuilt_from_authority by class policy.
durable_local_materialization under clear_data resolves to cleared_rebuildable_from_authority by class policy.
durable_local_materialization under export resolves to metadata_only_exported by class policy.
durable_local_materialization under support_bundle resolves to metadata_safe_in_bundle by class policy.
durable_local_materialization under offboarding resolves to local_cache_cleared_on_offboarding by class policy.
durable_local_materialization under restore resolves to rebuilt_from_authority by class policy.
exportable_snapshot under clear_data resolves to saved_artifact_preserved by class policy.
exportable_snapshot under export resolves to snapshot_artifact_exported by class policy.
exportable_snapshot under support_bundle resolves to snapshot_eligible_with_consent by class policy.
exportable_snapshot under offboarding resolves to retained_under_hold by class policy.
exportable_snapshot under restore resolves to restored_from_saved_artifact by class policy.
managed_replicated_view under clear_data resolves to local_replica_revoked_reconcile_later by class policy.
managed_replicated_view under export resolves to replica_metadata_exported by class policy.
managed_replicated_view under support_bundle resolves to replica_metadata_in_bundle by class policy.
managed_replicated_view under offboarding resolves to governed_by_managed_retention by class policy.
managed_replicated_view under restore resolves to reconciled_from_managed_source by class policy.

invariants: Every materialized view declares one of four classes (ephemeral projection, durable local materialization, exportable snapshot, managed replicated view); persistence, retention, export, delete, hold/offboarding, and support-bundle behavior follow from the class, never from a storage location alone.
No materialized-view class presents exact current truth on read; every read is a derived projection of an authority.
Clear-data, export, support-bundle, offboarding, and restore behavior is fixed per class in one disposition matrix, so each flow ingests the same table instead of reimplementing class behavior.

Managed-replicated and exportable-snapshot classes carry distinct retention, delete, hold, export, and support-bundle semantics from the ephemeral class; neither can silently inherit ephemeral eviction or retention.
Exportable snapshots are user-authored artifacts: a clear-data sweep preserves them and they are restored from the saved copy, never rebuilt from authority.
title: Canonical materialized-view-class persistence, export, and delete policy
